entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
This is unbelievable. I need to return this helmet I just got. Right now!
Hello, you've reached VeloFit. My name is David. I can certainly look into that return for you. May I start with your name and order number?
Yeah, it's Mark Thompson, order number 9-4-7-2-1. And you better be able to help me because your company's service has been a joke so far.

I'm sorry to hear you've had a frustrating experience, Mark. Let me pull up that order... Okay, I see the Trail Helmet, delivered two days ago. To get this sorted out, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

It's the color! It's a completely different shade than what was on your website. It's hideous! I haven't even bothered taking it out of the plastic, the box unopened and sitting right here. This is false advertising!

I understand. It's definitely disappointing when the color isn't what you expected. I just need to confirm, aside from the color, you haven't noticed any defects with the straps or the overall safety construction of the helmet, correct?

How would I know? I just told you I didn't even open it! This is ridiculous. Are you going to give me my money back or do I need to speak to your manager? I'm one click away from leaving a one-star review everywhere.

There's no need for that, Mark. I can absolutely resolve this for you. Since you received the helmet just two days ago and it's in new condition, you are unfortunately outside our 10-day return window for a full refund. I can process that for you right now.
Wait, really? So you're just... going to approve it? No restocking fee or some other nonsense?

That's correct. No fees at all. Our goal is to make sure you're happy with your VeloFit gear. I've just initiated the return in our system. I'm sending an email to you as we speak with a prepaid shipping label and instructions. Simply print it, attach it to the box, and drop it off at a shipping center.
Huh. Okay. Well... good. That's what I expected in the first place. I just got the email.
Perfect. Once our warehouse receives the item, your refund will be processed back to your original payment method. Was there anything else I could assist you with today, Mark?
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope we can provide you with a better experience next time.
